title: Mechanisms Underlying Impaired Diabetic Wound Healing
summary: The overall aim of this research is to utilize wound derived inflammatory cells from diabetic versus non diabetic human chronic wounds to understand mechanisms that are responsible for disregulated inflammation in individuals with diabetes. Biology of normal (peripheral blood derived cells) versus wound derived cells will also be studied.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ages 21-80
* Chronic Wound (present \>4 weeks)
* Diabetic \& Non-diabetic
* Adult surgical wounds

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to consent
* Pregnant women
* Therapeutically immunocompromised
* Individuals defined in 45 CFR 46 Subparts B,C, and D, nor from any other population considered vulnerable 2.9
